blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-11-27 at Base finalized block 62967570 (2026-11-27T12:51:29Z), Robinhood Chain block 124271103, and Ethereum finalized block 26506658. Unlike sister token mGLOBAL (which inherits mTokenPermissioned with a transfer greenlist), Sourcify exact-match mGLO.sol (Base impl 0xa311dce4469159300abe083fdba21431ec690753, Robinhood impl 0xf29aef8cbe31e5d257d6d3afab1580de8210f650, Ethereum impl 0xeeb64d1431c9297a3c77c3660be2195bfae553ac) inherits mToken and Blacklistable: _beforeTokenTransfer enforces _onlyNotBlacklisted against BLACKLISTED_ROLE on both sender and recipient, while M_GLO_PAUSE_OPERATOR_ROLE can pause transfers and M_GLO_BURN_OPERATOR_ROLE can burn tokens from arbitrary accounts. On Base MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b, BLACKLIST_OPERATOR_ROLE is held by 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 1-of-3 Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 and EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227. On Robinhood Chain MidasAccessControl 0xe5f087203f9e7a6104c821ec25b1f0a4505d3cb5, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 1-of-3 Safe 0x563e0fc290d535fc5549873aece97a16b001b9ed and EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227, and M_GLO_BURN_OPERATOR_ROLE is held by operator EOA 0xa13f82f679e24ad08e014f8af6ece32023b14f07. Because issuer operators can blacklist any holder, pause transfers, or burn balances directly, reviewedStatus is true.

oracleRisk.summary: mGLO is an issuer NAV-accreting tokenized certificate, not a market-priced asset. On Base, the canonical mGLO/USD oracle proxy 0x6b593a5fabb90f36e125562db833f761d274fcbc delegates to MGloCustomAggregatorFeed implementation 0x4a0a3eab5c75173c760b5a50a8570e5d20d9cc94 behind ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac, where Midas feed admins manually submit NAV updates validated against strategy-manager and JTC Luxembourg valuations. Third-party oracle networks are documented only for payment-token pricing; the certificate's own valuation authority is internal. At Base finalized block 62965587 (2026-11-27T12:44:53Z), latestRoundData() returned $1.01720039 (roundId 8, 8 decimals, updatedAt 2026-11-25T13:41:55Z).

branchApplicability.rationale: mGLO represents a managed private-credit fund share whose mint and redemption pricing come from the issuer NAV. No borrower market is owned by mGLO itself; external lending markets such as Morpho Base vaults that accept mGLO as collateral are downstream integrations rather than the certificate's own pricing mechanism.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mGLO has native issuer deployments on Base, Robinhood Chain, and Ethereum, interconnected with X Layer, Optimism, and Monad through immutable 27,366-byte LayerZero V2 MidasLzMintBurnOFTAdapter contracts. Verified adapters directly burn source-chain mGLO and mint destination-chain mGLO with zero locked token escrow across all six chains, making supply additive across all six deployments. Adapter owners (1-of-3 Midas Safes) can change peers, endpoint configuration, and rate limits, while X Layer, Optimism, and Monad representation-chain operator, admin, and proxy-upgrade controls remain material Bridge Risk surfaces.
